title: Dimension Bound of Singular Set of One-Phase Free Boundary Problems in Spaces with Two-Sided Ricci Bound
summary: In this article, we show that for one-phase free boundary problems in noncollapsed limits of $n$-dimensional manifolds with two-sided Ricci curvature bounds, the Hausdorff dimension of the singular set of the free boundary can be bounded by $n-5$, which is sharp in this context.
